assignments.title: Model Quality & Information Review
assignments.competencyObjective: Inspect model structure and information consistency, identify production-readiness risks, and recommend corrective action.
assignments.context: Use an approved sanitized or synthetic training model locally. Native model files remain outside BCL evidence upload.
assignments.instructions: Review the assigned model against the mentor-approved QA/QC checklist. Document structure, naming, levels/grids, parameters, completeness, drawing/QTO readiness, critical findings, and corrective recommendations.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF model-quality review report plus XLSX/CSV checklist and optional annotated PNG/JPG screenshots.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: The review is technically coherent, findings are traceable and prioritised, and no critical QA/QC issue is unexplained.
dependencies: Mentor-approved QA/QC case and standard checklist

caseData.executionContract: Provide one non-confidential training model with known quality issues and an approved checklist.

assignments.title: Federated Model Coordination & Clash Review
assignments.competencyObjective: Review federated discipline alignment, classify coordination issues, assign priorities/ownership, and communicate recheck logic.
assignments.context: Perform federation and clash work locally with an approved ARS/STR/MEP set; submit only derived reports, logs, and screenshots.
assignments.instructions: Verify discipline alignment, run or review clash tests, group and prioritise issues, propose ownership and resolution, and document revision/recheck traceability.
expectedWorkflow: Verify files, coordinates, units, and assumptions.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF coordination report plus XLSX/CSV clash/issue log and representative PNG/JPG screenshots.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: Setup assumptions are explicit, material issues are correctly classified and traceable, and coordination actions are usable.

caseData.executionContract: Provide aligned non-confidential discipline models with known issues and an approved clash-test brief.

assignments.title: 4D Model-Schedule Linkage
assignments.competencyObjective: Translate WBS/activity structure into model grouping and common-ID model-schedule linkage, then validate sequence and data issues.
assignments.context: Use a mentor-approved synthetic model/WBS exercise locally. Submit a report, mapping table, and sequence screenshots rather than native models or video.
assignments.instructions: Interpret the supplied WBS, define grouping and common-ID rules, map groups to activities, validate missing/duplicate/format errors, review sequence logic, and document corrections.
expectedWorkflow: Review WBS, IDs, dates, and dependencies.
Create and validate the mapping table.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF 4D workflow report, XLSX/CSV model-activity/common-ID mapping, and PNG/JPG sequence screenshots.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: WBS interpretation, common-ID rules, mapping, validation, and sequence reasoning are coherent and traceable.
dependencies: Approved synthetic model and schedule exercise

caseData.executionContract: Provide a non-confidential model breakdown and schedule with stable IDs, dependencies, and deliberate mapping errors.

assignments.title: QTO / 5D Validation
assignments.competencyObjective: Extract quantities, validate model readiness, reconcile against a reference, and explain material discrepancies.
assignments.context: Use an approved synthetic or sanitized quantity case locally; submit tabular extracts and methodology/reconciliation evidence only.
assignments.instructions: Check quantity-scope readiness, extract quantities, compare them with the supplied BOQ/reference, analyse discrepancies, and document reliability limits.
expectedWorkflow: Confirm scope, units, and reference basis.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: XLSX/CSV quantity extract and reconciliation plus PDF methodology/discrepancy report with optional images.
assignments.acceptanceExpectation: Extraction is reproducible, discrepancies are reasoned, and no critical reliability concern is unresolved.

caseData.executionContract: Provide a non-confidential model quantity scope and reference table with known discrepancies.

assignments.title: Automation / Digital Workflow Improvement
assignments.competencyObjective: Identify a real repetitive BIM/data problem, design and validate an automation improvement, benchmark value, collect feedback, and govern handover evidence.
assignments.context: Implementation remains local and mentor-approved. Source code, executables, secrets, and native project files are not uploaded; BCL receives derived evidence and an external-repository governance record only.
assignments.instructions: Audit the baseline workflow, define the data/ID architecture, prototype a controlled improvement, validate missing/duplicate/format/error cases, benchmark time/steps/errors/repeatability, collect mentor/user feedback, revise the result, and document safe use, limitations, release identity, and handover.
expectedWorkflow: Approve the problem, users, baseline, tool, and non-confidential case.
Define information architecture and validation controls.
Prototype locally without uploading source or executables.
Validate output and benchmark practical benefit.
Document limitations, external release identity, SOP, and next action.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF/DOCX technical report, XLSX/CSV benchmark and validation outputs, PDF/DOCX governance/SOP record, and PNG/JPG evidence.

deliverables.name: Governance, SOP, feedback, and external release record

assignments.acceptanceExpectation: The mentor explicitly accepts a useful and repeatable improvement with validated outputs, measurable benefit, feedback-driven revision, safe-use limits, and traceable external release governance.
dependencies: Mentor-led prerequisite until a dedicated automation module is approved

caseData.executionContract: Mentor approves one non-confidential repetitive workflow, baseline dataset, local toolchain, users for feedback, and external release-governance boundary before work starts.

assignments.title: BIM Documentation, Governance & Handover Package
assignments.competencyObjective: Assemble a controlled delivery and handover package covering naming/status, revisions/issues, applicable tool/SOP documentation, limitations, knowledge transfer, and closeout sign-off.
assignments.context: Use derived outputs from approved exercises. Do not expose production locations, secrets, native project files, source code, or executables.
assignments.instructions: Build a delivery/revision/issue register, check output consistency, document CDE and responsibility assumptions, include user/workflow/limitation/SOP notes for any automation, prepare a handover backlog, and deliver a concise final presentation with mentor sign-off.
expectedWorkflow: Define delivery scope, authority, naming, and status rules.
Check consistency and record open actions.
Document workflow, limitations, responsibilities, SOP, and external artifact references where applicable.
Prepare handover backlog and final presentation.
Capture mentor closeout sign-off separately from rubric scoring.
assignments.requiredDeliverable: PDF/DOCX governance and handover narrative, XLSX/CSV delivery/revision/issue register, and PDF presentation/sign-off evidence.

deliverables.name: Deliverable, revision, issue, and backlog register

assignments.acceptanceExpectation: The mentor explicitly accepts a structured, consistent, traceable package that communicates governance, limitations, responsibilities, handover status, and closeout evidence.

caseData.executionContract: Provide non-confidential derived outputs and a delivery scenario with revisions, issue states, handover requirements, and applicable automation documentation.

assignments.title: Capstone / Improvement Project
assignments.context: No approved case, scope, prerequisite bundle, or governance exists.
dependencies: Future scope, case, mentor capacity, and rubric approval
